messages:
Fiona (RevOps): Quick alert  partner marketing credits from Q1 were booked as immediate sales discounts instead of deferred marketing contra-revenue. seeing a $28,750 variance in recognized revenue for April. need triage.
Ken (Billing): Which partner SKUs/invoices?
Fiona (RevOps): SKU = PARTNER-MKT-CR. Sample invoices: INV-15077 (CloudEdge) $15,000, INV-15089 (DataNexus) $8,250, INV-15105 (VectorX) $5,500. Terms: credits apply over 12 months to co-sell activity.
Avery (Accounting): So GL used was 4105 Sales Discounts instead of 2399 Deferred Contra-Revenue? we'll need to reclass remaining amortizable portion as of 4/30.
Ken (Billing): Confirmed mapping file accidentally routed PARTNER-MKT-CR -> 4105 due to fallback.
Rolf (Controller): Materiality: CloudEdge >10k but under 25k. Still flag for Head Revenue sign-off. Also decide PPC vs normal correction based on timing.
Fiona (RevOps): Exported amort schedule shows remaining as of 4/30: CloudEdge 13,750 (11/12), DataNexus 7,333.33, VectorX 5,041.67. link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/partner-mkt-export (view).
Avery (Accounting): Draft JEs to reclassify remaining balances as of 4/30. Example CloudEdge:
DR 4105 Sales Discounts 13,750
CR 2399 Deferred Contra-Revenue 13,750
Memo: Reclass PARTNER-MKT-CR remaining balance for INV-15077; attach amort schedule.
Mina (Head Revenue): I approve the reclassification treatment. For CloudEdge, treat as current period correction but document in close notes since aggregate impact >$15k.
audit-bot: Note: any reclassification >$20k flagged for disclosure.
Rolf (Controller): Ok. Even though no single >25k, cumulated impact is material for the month; include a one-line disclosure.
Ken (Billing): I'll add a rule to map PARTNER-MKT-CR to GL 2399 and add a unit test. Opening ticket BC-4720.
billing-bot: Ticket BC-4720 created, owner -> billing-engineer.
Avery (Accounting): Posting JEs today: NS-JE-595210 (CloudEdge), NS-JE-595211 (DataNexus), NS-JE-595212 (VectorX). Memos include invoice refs and amort schedule link.
Fiona (RevOps): I'll attach partner agreements and the CSV to the NS JEs for audit trail.
Mina (Head Revenue): Approved. Please include short audit rationale in JE memo: "Partner marketing credits represent reimbursements/consideration for future joint go-to-market activity and should be recognized ratably over the contract term."
Rolf (Controller): Action items recap: 1) Avery post reclass JEs and include evidence; 2) Ken implement billing mapping change and unit tests; 3) Fiona attach partner docs and circulate updated revenue rollforward; 4) Mina approve disclosure language. Deadline: EOD next business day.
billing-bot: Billing PR BC-PR-1024 opened and CI green; staging deploy scheduled tonight.
Avery (Accounting): JEs posted and rollforward updated. NS-JE-595210..595212 posted. Closing loop.
